subject: scan_fusion_node live verification (4 LiDAR + front RGB-D -> 2D occupancy map)

rig.lidars: none mounted yet - four synthetic LaserScan publishers used instead

live_runs.cause: camera_depth_optical_frame carries forward distance in z; the height band mistook depth for altitude

live_runs.scans: 4 x 181-sample LaserScan, 10 Hz, wall at 3.0-3.1 m, 15-sample inf gap
live_runs.note: 206 of 292 occupied cells lie outside the camera's +/-43 deg FoV, so the four mount yaws are contributing

conclusions: Mapper ray integration is not the Orin Nano bottleneck; RGB-D cloud transport is (halving the mapper rate changed CPU by ~2 points, quartering the cloud cut it by ~18).
RGB-D clouds must be converted from optical axes (x right, y down, z forward) to body axes before any height-band filter; covered by an offline regression test.
Bench pose must sit inside the map extent (a corner pose clipped half the sensor FoV outside the grid).
